question: Should the remaining work stay as this Linux companion app umbrella, or should maintainers split it into a narrower Linux app architecture/security tracker now that Windows Hub has shipped?
rationale: The current issue spans product direction, security posture, packaging ownership, and competing implementation approaches, which automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Keep this issue open for Linux companion direction until maintainers choose the app architecture and review a security/proof-ready implementation path.

options.title: Split Linux tracker
options.body: Close or narrow this issue after creating a focused Linux companion tracker that captures GTK/Tauri direction, packaging, security review, and validation requirements.

options.title: Defer native Linux app
options.body: Document the Gateway-only Linux path as the supported direction for now and close app-specific implementation attempts until a maintainer sponsors the product direction.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for Linux companion direction until maintainers choose the app architecture and review a security/proof-ready implementation path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the request, commented on the preferred Linux direction, and is the strongest product-direction signal in the discussion.
